title: Sunlit loft in the heart of Lisbon
description: Wake up above the rooftops in this bright, thoughtfully restored loft. Walk to cafés, galleries and the old town, then unwind on the little balcony at sunset.
extraInfo: The apartment is on the third floor; the building has no elevator.

title: A quiet cabin tucked into the pines
description: A warm timber cabin with mountain air, forest trails just outside and a fire waiting for slow evenings together.
extraInfo: Road access can be affected by snow during winter months.

title: Barefoot days at a Goa beach house
description: An airy beach house steps from the sand, with a shaded porch for long breakfasts and the Arabian Sea at the end of the lane.
extraInfo: Quiet hours begin at 10 pm to respect the local neighbourhood.

title: Minimal design home with valley views
description: Clean lines, handmade details and a wide terrace looking over the Aravalli hills. A calm base for exploring the lakeside city.
extraInfo: A local host can arrange an airport pickup on request.

title: Heritage haveli courtyard room
description: Stay in a restored haveli with hand-painted details, a leafy courtyard and the old city's markets a short walk away.
extraInfo: Breakfast is served from 8 to 10 am in the courtyard.

title: Countryside farmhouse under the stars
description: A relaxed farmhouse surrounded by coffee country. Spend the day on winding plantation paths and the evening around the garden firepit.
extraInfo: The final kilometre is on an unpaved road.

title: Clifftop escape above the blue sea
description: A breezy hideaway perched above the coast. The cliff path, swimming spots and small cafés are all close by.
extraInfo: The path to the property includes a short flight of steps.

title: A little lakeside cottage for two
description: A snug cottage with pine-framed lake views, a reading nook and a short stroll down to the water.
extraInfo: The cottage is best reached on foot for the last 150 metres.
